page.layout: One page of text in italic verse, with marginal notes in the left margin (references and island names beside the lines). Running head at top right. Page number at top left. Catchword-free. Final word "MARE" set right-aligned at foot of text.

p.i:
Sed pater omnipotens speluncis abdidit atris
Hoc metuens: molemque, & montes insuper altos
Impositi, regemque dedit, qui fœdere certo
Et premere, & laxas sciret iussus habenas

Insula Sicanium iuxta latus, Æoliamque
Erigitur Liparem, fumantibus ardua saxis,
Quam subter specus, & Cyclopum exesa caminis
Antra Ætnaea tonant, validisque in cudibus ictus
Auditi referunt gemitum, stridúntque cavernis
Strictura chalybum, & fornacibus ignis anhelat:
Vulcani domus, & Vulcania nomine tellus.

Hoc tunc ignipotens cælo descendit ab alto.
Ferrum exercebant vasto Cyclopes in antro,
Brontesque, Steropesque, & nudus membra Pyracmon.

Tradunt Herculea prostratos mole gigantes
Tellurem iniectam quatere, & spiramine anhelo
Torreri late campos, quotiesque minatur
Rumpere compagem impositam, expallescere cælum,

Apparet Prochytæ sæuum fortita Mimanta.
Apparet procul Inaryme, quæ turbine nigro
Fumantem premit Iapetum, flammasque rebelli
Ore eiectantem, & si quando euadere detur,
Bella Iovi rursus superisque iterare volentem.

p.note: Stat. Syl. li. 2. Nesis insula. Euplæa insula. Megalia insula.
p.i:
Hæc videt Iranimen, illi Prochyta aspera paret,
Armiger hac magni patet Heloris: inde malignum
Æra respirat pelago circumflua Nesis:
Inde vagis omen felix Euplea carinis,
Quaque ferit curuos exerta Megalia fluctus
Angitur: & domino contra recubante, proculque
Surrentina tuus spectat pratoria Limon.

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly faint; the references "Virg. Aen. lib. 8.", "Sil. Ita. li. 12.", "Stat. Syl. li. 2." and island names are read with some doubt. Several words in the verse are blurred and may contain printing errors (e.g. "Iranimen", "Heloris", "Nesis" for Nesis/Nessis).
